id: # The sites of the map: 42 cities (id 0 to 41), 10 passes (42 to 51) and 35 ports (52 to 86), the same counts as the placeholder pack.
# lat and lon: degrees, WGS84. The positions are the historic town centres. These facts are common knowledge. Wikidata (CC0) has the same values.
# slots: the number of development slots that the tool tries to place. specialty: the specialty of cities.tsv. Passes and ports use -.
# owner: the city id of a pass or a port. - = the nearest city.
